Composition and visual reference:

Dark conifer trees shrink into the distance beneath a cloudy gray sky. Rough metal, leather and snow textures create a muted, naturalistic winter battle scene.

Art treatment:

Distinguish painted metal, glass, rubber, concrete, soil and foliage through restrained roughness, reflectance and surface detail. Keep scale, perspective and contact with the ground believable. Use reflections and shadow direction to communicate form, not merely to add spectacle. Compose the view with an identifiable focal object and enough surrounding context to explain its environment. UI should remain unobtrusive, with effects grounded in plausible dust, spray or motion.
